# Read AGENTS.md first

This repo is worked on by several AI agents in turn. **Read `AGENTS.md`** (the
owner, the rules, in-flight branches, the backlog), then `CLAUDE.md` (dev notes:
layout, build, deploy, tests — it applies to every agent, not just Claude), then
`3d/ARCHITECTURE.md`. Update the "In-flight work" table in `AGENTS.md` when you
start, pause or finish something.
